Klasse Rover

java.lang.Object
greenfoot.Actor
Rover
public class Rover extends greenfoot.Actor
The Rover is the main character of the game. The Rover is controlled by one of two players. It can drive, turn ad shoot (at least if it has munitions wich can be picked up). When hit it lossed lives until it is dead and the game is over.
Version:
0.3.0 - 02.10.2025
Autor:
Paul Jonas Dohle

      Parameter:
      forward - if true, the rover will move forward, if false, it will move backward

    • drive

      Parameter:

    • shoot

      public void shoot()
      Shoots a beam in the direction the rover is currently facing. The beam will move until it hits the edge of the world, a hill or another rover. If it hits a rover, the rover which was hit will loose one life. If it hits a hill, the beam will be destroyed. The beam will move in a straight line until it hits something. It consumes one munition per shot. The rover cannot shoot while burning or if it has no munitions left.
      Siehe auch:
      • Rover.Beam

    • hit

      public void hit()
      Called when the rover has been hit by a beam. The rover will loose one life. If the life count reaches zero, the rover will start to burn.

    • burn

      public void burn()
      Called when the rover's life count reaches zero. A Fire actor will be added to the world, indicating that the rover has been destroyed.

      public boolean isObjectAhead(Class<? extends greenfoot.Actor> object)
      Checks if there is an object of the specified class directly ahead of the rover. The rover's direction is taken into account.
      Parameter:

      Gibt zurück:
      true if there is an object ahead, false otherwise
